name: Bond of Fauna (Faunal)
body:
Your awakening bond with nature graces you with the ability to sense and commune with animal life.

Prerequisite(s): Wilderling or Blessed by the Wild, must not have Bond of Flora

Benefit(s): Your appearance changes, taking on purely visual elements reminiscent of an animal, from skin coloration that looks like a deer with spots, eyes that look to be from another species, feathers for hair, or other such aspects. You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day with a caster level equal to your character level:

Detect Animals: as detect animals or plants, but can only be used on animals.
Speak with Animals

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
